Then the "AC-READ" entry names the three template codes and holds no template status and no merge value

  Scenario: AC10 A service identity is refused by the same right check as a person (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the role row of "SY-CASEWF" is of class "NON_HUMAN_ACTOR" with scope "ALL", and its permission row in "PM-2026.12" holds the letter "R" for area "DOCUMENTS" and no letter "C"
    When "SY-CASEWF" asks the authorise path for area "DOCUMENTS", right "C" on case "RW-2026-000301" and treatment "TRT-0301"
    Then the call is refused with status 403 and message MSG-P4-002 for the action "generate documents" and the area "DOCUMENTS"
    Then one access-log entry exists with decision code "AC-DENY", actor "SY-CASEWF", case "RW-2026-000301", area "DOCUMENTS", right "C" and reason "NO_RIGHT"

  Scenario: AC11 An authorise call that carries no caller identity is refused with status 401 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the authorise call for area "DOCUMENTS", right "C" on case "RW-2026-000301" and treatment "TRT-0301" carries no identity of the caller
    When the call is made to POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise
    Then the call is refused with status 401
    Then no allowed answer is returned and no data of the case is sent
